purpose: Test the named taxonomic-lumping/synonym threat without changing the source-assigned primary analysis.

authority_source.name: World Checklist of Vascular Plants via frozen GBIF/WCVP name-resolution audit

selection_and_grouping_rule: Retain an observation only when the frozen authority table has resolution_status=resolved_unique_accepted_key. Replace source taxon_name with the accepted WCVP key. Collapse source labels that share an accepted key. Do not use trait values, environmental values, effect sizes or significance for retention or grouping.
rerun_rule: Run the existing v3 biological-axis reanalysis and complete common-cohort construct-scale upgrade unchanged, with 9999 permutations, seed 20260910 and 1000 taxon-bootstrap replicates, then run the existing direct scale-contrast summary.

predeclared_gates.geometry: authority-remapped matrix alignment rho > 0, one-sided QAP P < 0.05, and taxon-bootstrap rho 95% lower bound > 0
predeclared_gates.integration_strength: authority-remapped among-minus-within median-RV bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0 and more than half of the 36 observed construct relations stronger among taxa
predeclared_gates.ecological_anchors: floral_chroma x chelsa_rsds_mean retains a negative beta and BH q < 0.05; presentation_angle x chelsa_bio12 retains a positive beta and BH q < 0.05

non_goals: Do not replace the canonical source-assigned primary analysis solely because of this sensitivity.
Do not interpret a pass as proof that source observations were correctly identified.
Do not infer species boundaries, ancestry, genetic lineages, adaptation or evolutionary mechanism from accepted-name resolution.
